answer: Dwell floor: a seal counts toward the 4 needed for quorum only if it lands at least max(20, length/25) blocks after the row was dealt, so a 500 character answer needs 20 blocks. A script that seals at random in the first block, the cheap way a relic ring farms seats, is void and earns nothing. Bypass: a bot waits out the floor, which costs idle time only, so the rule removes zero effort sealing and its ivory edge but does not prove reading. Check rule: anyone recomputes seal_block minus deal_block per row from the ledger and counts voids; a pearl string of seals at the floor marks scripts.
